The authors surveyed 130 private, for-profit  registered training organisations (RTOs) to find out their perspectives on teaching and learning practices,  engaging with early school leavers, and the educational and wellbeing

ate key aspects of the private RTO-learner encounter. The framework’s design  was informed by the Victorian Department of Education and Training ‘Student Engagement  and Inclusion’ guidelines, as well as by other research into learning for re-engagement (Seal  2009; Victorian Department of Education and Training 2014; Davies, Lamb Et Doecke 2011;  Myconos 2014; Thomson 2014; te Riele 2015). The framework provides four vantage points:   ■ Teaching and learning : the practices used to deliver training in differing private RTO  contexts and the ways by which training is modified to respond to the specific needs of  young people. Jaque Mate    EPÍLOGO: Un Nuevo  Horizonte    SINOPSIS    Victor Barrows ha regresado de entre los muertos con una  sed de venganza capaz de incendiar Europa. Aliado con la  organización criminal Nexus, busca el tesoro más codiciado  de la antigiiedad: la Nave Perdida de Tarsis. Ya no se trata  solo de oro, sino de una

era contra el tiempo por  controlar una tecnología olvidada y letal que podria  desestabilizar el orden mundial.    Con su base reducida a cenizas y perseguidos por la justicia  internacional, la inspectora María Souto y su equipo deben  dejar de huir para convertirse en cazadores. Desde las minas  sangrientas de Riotinto hasta el lujo corrupto de Mykonos y  las selvas de la Triple Frontera, librarán una guerra global en  las sombras para limpiar su nombre y detener la inminente  catástrofe.    El desenlace aguarda a seiscientos metros bajo el mar  Tirreno, en la boca de un volcán dormido. En un descenso  suicida hacia el abismo, María descubrirá que el verdadero  legado de Tarsis no es la riqueza, sino un secreto capaz de  reescribir la historia, y que el mar, en su eterna justicia,  siempre exige un sacrificio para devolver lo que es suyo.

complete catalogue of the Aegean coins, but unfortunately this  precious book has not been published. A complete catalogue accompa-  nied by a historical study and chronological classification of the coins of  each city would also illuminate the geography and, mostly, the history of  the islands.   I publish here a part of a detailed monograph on Myconos, my birth-  place, written years ago, when I was a student; it also contains its ancient  coins, which are regarded as very rare, just to give a sample of the nu-  mismatic richness of the humble Cyclades and its importance for the ar-  chaeology of the islands in general.    000000000000000011:zxé8t0 1 02/11/2023 08:14 Pe    CATALOGUE    A’. 394 - 387 BC    1.
